- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `OTHER-CAUSE`, `DEMO-FEEDBACK`, `RESEARCH`
- **Budget:** at most 16 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `one-action`, `errors` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Chen's goal is behind, and none of the named causes fits: Something else, in his own words.
- Open a fresh browser as Chen (`chen`).
- Go to `/check-in/dep-jenkins` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type {a number 40% of the way from the goal’s start to its plan for week 45} into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Something changed” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Something else” button in the “Main cause” group.
- **Step.** Type “A reorganisation moved the Jenkins job owners to another team mid-week.” into the “What happened” field.
- _Note:_ Last week's plan is still word for word: say it's still true (deep review U9).
- If the “Still true this week” field is visible:
  - **Step.** Press the “Still true this week” field.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “something else”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the Something else cause was not saved.
- _Note:_ Feedback in the demo says it goes to the people building the app (it used to stay in the browser).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page shows.
- _Note:_ Feedback is one item (WR5): its page's Send feedback opens the sheet.
- **Step.** Open “Feedback” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
- **Step.** Press the “Send feedback” button.
- **Step.** Press the “It gets in the way” button in the “How is the app working for you?” dialog.
- **Step.** Type “The causes didn’t fit my week.” into a field in the “How is the app working for you?” dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “feedback”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Send” button in the “How is the app working for you?” dialog.
- **Check:** “It goes to the people building this app” is shown (else: demo feedback does not say where it goes).
- **Check:** (`attention`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ A research session ends after its last task: no repeats of it, and a way to the report.
- Reload the page.
- If the “Save” button in the “Research” side panel is visible:
  - Press the “Skip / Not now / Close / Cancel” button in the “Research” side panel.
- **Step.** Press the “How did it go?” button in the “Research” side panel.
- **Step.** Press the “Done” field in the “Research” side panel.
- **Step.** Press the “Save and next task” button in the “Research” side panel.
- **Check:** “All 11 tasks noted” is shown in the “Research” side panel (else: the research bar does not say the tasks are done).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “research done”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if after the last task: {again} “How did it go?” buttons, {report} report links.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
